name: Kimberly Kenne
office: Pasadena Unified School District, Board of Education, District No. 1

items.text: Kimberly Kenne represents District 1 on the Pasadena Unified School District Board of Education, first elected in 2011. A systems integration expert and parent leader, she has chaired the District Advisory Council and helped found the Parent Education Network.

sentences.text: Kimberly Kenne represents District 1 on the Pasadena Unified School District Board of Education, first elected in 2011.
A systems integration expert and parent leader, she has chaired the District Advisory Council and helped found the Parent Education Network.

items.text: In 2026, she opposed ending Professional Learning Communities for elementary schools, calling it a mistake. She calls for greater budget transparency and aligning spending with planning and values. Kenne is open to school closures if a consolidation process recommends them. She moved to delay rebuilding San Rafael Elementary until that process finishes, warning against committing bond money before the district completes its facilities master plan. She has criticized one-time state funding for causing repeated layoffs.
